UserProfile.title: UserProfile
UserProfile.description: User profile state containing levels, experience points, streaks, and styling preferences.

lastActive.description: The last UTC timestamp the user was active.

avatar.description: The emoji avatar chosen by the user.

background.description: The selected CSS background theme string.

language.description: The preferred language UI locale code.

preferredPlaylist.description: The preferred audio playlist embed link URL.

Task.title: Task
Task.description: A planning task or protocol decomposed to simple steps.

title.description: The title or action of the task.

description.description: Detailed notes on what this task entails.

duration.description: Estimated minutes required for task focus.

completed.description: Whether the task has been finished by user.

createdAt.description: The UTC timestamp the task was created.

question.description: The prompt or front of the card.

answer.description: The response or back of the card.

nextReview.description: The scheduled boundary of next self-test.

title.description: The description or name of the target goal.

currentHours.description: Fulfilled study hours tracked so far.

category.description: The associated department or category label.

SessionTodo.title: SessionTodo
SessionTodo.description: An interactive task item tied to the active study session.

/users/{userId}.description: Global user statistics, leveling and styling preferences.

/users/{userId}/tasks/{taskId}.description: Sub-collection containing decomposed tasks belonging to the user.

/users/{userId}/flashcards/{cardId}.description: Sub-collection containing memory cards scheduled for review.

/users/{userId}/goals/{goalId}.description: Sub-collection containing multi-hour targets defined by user.

/users/{userId}/session_todos/{todoId}.description: Sub-collection containing session-specific todo list items.
